equation_summary: Mamba-1 selective scan keeps a per-channel SSM state x in [B,D,N]. The recurrence (selective_scan_ref, interface.py:162-175) is x_i = deltaA_i * x_{i-1} + deltaB_u_i, where deltaA_i = exp(delta_i * A) with delta_i the per-timestep input-dependent step size and A a [D,N] parameter; deltaB_u_i = delta_i * B_i * u_i (input-modulated input). Output y_i = C_i . x_i (plus D*u skip and optional z gate). The KEY point: deltaA_i is a DIAGONAL transition (scalar per channel, exp of delta*A), but delta_i (and B_i,C_i) are DATA-DEPENDENT (selective) — they vary per token as functions of the input.
gate_scope: data-dependent (selective): delta_i, B_i, C_i all vary per token; transition deltaA_i=exp(delta_i*A) is diagonal but data-modulated
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM ledger call graph `E[projection/short conv/activation] ; B[K2 diagonal selective SSM] ; E[skip/output gate/cache]` — projection/conv external; the diagonal selective SSM scan is the blocked region.

CONFIRM ledger blocker `Input-precomputable coefficients, scan/step equivalence` — delta,B,C are produced by the external projection frontend and are input-precomputable (they depend on the input token, NOT on the recurrent state x), so the coefficient is data-dependent on the input but NOT state-dependent.

ANSWER to task question: the recurrence is a diagonal transition, but the SELECTIVE (input-dependent) delta/B/C make it data-dependent on the input token. It is NOT state-dependent (A10 is stochastic routes — not applicable). The correct characterization: the coefficients are input-precomputable, so this is the A8 read/write-coupling axis case of 'input-precomputable versus state-dependent coefficients'. It is NOT plain fixed-decay K2 because the decay deltaA_i=exp(delta_i*A) varies per token (a per-token diagonal gate scope), distinct from a fixed decay.

MISSING-BLOCKER nuance: the ledger should make explicit that the per-token diagonal gate (deltaA_i varies per token) is a gate-scope/read-timing descriptor difference from canonical fixed-G K2, even though the coefficients are input-precomputable.
axis: A8 read/write coupling (input-precomputable coefficients) + per-token diagonal gate scope descriptor
direction_justification: Mamba-1 is a diagonal-transition SSM whose coefficients (delta,B,C) are input-precomputable but vary per token, so it is a per-token diagonal gate + input-precomputable-coefficient case of A8 rather than the canonical fixed-decay K2; the scan/step equivalence and gate descriptor must be recorded before any K2 substitution.
